title: Recording: Easy For Me by Ringo Starr | 1974
content:
Sunset Sound Recorders, Los Angeles
Producer: Richard Perry
Engineer: Bill Schnee

Ringo Starr finished recording ‘Easy For Me’ for his fourth studio album, Goodnight Vienna, on 16 October 1974.

The backing track had been recorded at unknown dates in July and August 1974. It featured a string arrangement by Trevor Lawrence and Vini Poncia, and the session musicians were conducted by producer Richard Perry.

‘Easy For Me’ was written by Harry Nilsson, who appeared alongside Starr in the music video for the album’s lead single ‘Only You’.

Nilsson wrote this next track and it’s the only one on the album with full orchestra. It’s piano, my voice and orchestra. We did the basic track just with piano, and then we overdubbed the orchestra. Trevor Lawrence and Vini Poncia arranged the strings on this one and Richard Perry conducted it. It’s a nice slow ballad, and I thank Harry very much for writing it for me, because it’s so beautiful.
Ringo Starr
Rockspeak, BBC Radio 1, 8 November 1974
